messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Automated alert - service=\"inference-api\" metric=\"p99_latency\" region=us-west-2 value=2400ms SLO_burn=18% (5m). PagerDuty: INC-4532 fired to oncall.
alex: ack. I'm on it. grabbing logs + starting triage.
sam: data from observability - p95 jumped to ~700ms, p99 ~2.4s, error rate flat. traffic volume spiked ~3x from a few heavy embedding jobs (src: viz-co).
lee: seeing many long tail requests pinned to large-seq routes (/chat/stream with max_tokens=4096). KV cache hit rate dropped to 12%.
maria: can we temporarily route viz-co to their dedicated capacity? they have a reserved pool but not currently attached to this model.
alex: checking routing table now. we have a compatible lite-quant model (gptx-lite-q4) in dedicated pool A, I'll try a soft-failover.
jen: +1 for soft failover. also recommend lowering batch sizes for that route to reduce head-of-line blocking.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty INC-4532 acknowledged by alex. Escalation policy: default -> staging-sre if unacked in 10m.
sam: quick query: are there any recent deploys? CI shows a small tokenizer change 2h ago, but rollout flag off. unlikely.
lee: logs: repeated slow calls to attention-kernel on host gpu-12, memory pressure spikes then GC inside runtime. suspect kernel scheduling/oversubscribe.
maria: if gpu-12 is the hotspot, can we drain new work from it and reroute to other healthy nodes?
alex: initiating drain on gpu-12, mark node read-only for new allocations. triggering reroute policy -> prefer node pool B.
jen: I'm flipping the model variant for the public route to gptx-lite-q4 (graceful fallback) — this should reduce median latency but might slightly change outputs. notify support.
sam: after reroute p95 down to 320ms, p99 to 820ms within 60s. SLO burn dropped to 4%.
lee: still seeing a few >1.5s tails tied to long sequences; will add a short-term token cap of 2048 for bursty customers (
```
config:
  route: /chat/stream
  token_limit: 2048
```
)
maria: notifying account team about temporary routing + token cap for viz-co.
alex: good mitigation. I'll keep the node drain running and monitor for 15m. if burn stays <5% we'll close.
jen: leaving a note for postmortem: investigate KV cache eviction policy and autoscaler ramp for dedicated pool B.
incident-bot: Incident INC-4532 status: acknowledged -> mitigated (SLO_burn 4%). last update by alex.
alex: closing thread in 20m if steady. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
